mcq: Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is used to confirm whether a person has been infected with HIV."
A blood test is used to confirm whether a person has been infected with HIV.

Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is one of the top three causes of death for African American men aged 25-54 and for African American women aged 35-44 years in the United States of America."
AIDS is one of the top three causes of death for African American men aged 25-54 and for African American women aged 35-44 years in the United States of America.

Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the rate at which a certain event occurs in a defined population during a specific period of time, e.g. the number of new cases of HIV infection that occurred in Nigeria during 2005."
Incidence is the rate at which a certain event occurs in a defined population during a specific period of time, e.g. the number of new cases of HIV infection that occurred in Nigeria during 2005.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ are a necessary part of HIV prevention in any community that contains injecting drug users (WHO, 2005)."
Needle exchanges are a necessary part of HIV prevention in any community that contains injecting drug users (WHO, 2005).
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ means 'slow virus' because they take such a long time to produce any adverse effects in the body."
The name 'lentivirus' literally means 'slow virus' because they take such a long time to produce any adverse effects in the body.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ refers to sexual activities which do not involve any blood or sexual fluid from one person getting into another person's body."
Safe sex refers to sexual activities which do not involve any blood or sexual fluid from one person getting into another person's body.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a lentivirus, and like all viruses of this type, it attacks the immune system."
HIV is a lentivirus, and like all viruses of this type, it attacks the immune system.

Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a very sensitive and professional practice which requires rules and checklist geared towards protecting the client and making a positive test result as less traumatic as possible."
HIV counseling is a very sensitive and professional practice which requires rules and checklist geared towards protecting the client and making a positive test result as less traumatic as possible.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is considered a very low risk activity for transmission of HIV."
Deep or open mouthed kissing is considered a very low risk activity for transmission of HIV.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the major mode of HIV transmission."
Sexual intercourse is the major mode of HIV transmission.

Complete the statement from the course material: "______ are the only form of protection that can both help to stop the transmission of sexually transmitted diseases (STDs) such as HIV and prevent pregnancy."
Condoms are the only form of protection that can both help to stop the transmission of sexually transmitted diseases (STDs) such as HIV and prevent pregnancy.
